dek: A sushi takeout chain has initiated an investigation after a customer found a suspected worm in a box of salmon sushi sold at a branch in Tsuen Wan. Sushi Express Hong Kong said in a Facebook post on Sunday that it had sent a sample for third-party testing, and that it would publicise the results […]
